description: LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation rubric for the Google Ads AI Support Assistant. A secondary model uses this rubric to score live assistant responses and flag quality drift.
evaluation_model: Secondary auditor model (separate from primary assistant)

dimensions.name: Grounding
dimensions.description: Does the response cite a specific knowledge chunk and policy ID? Is the cited rule accurate and directly relevant to the advertiser's situation?

scoring_criteria.5: Policy ID cited, chunk ID cited, rule directly matches the advertiser's situation, no unsupported claims.
scoring_criteria.4: Policy ID cited, rule is correct, minor mismatch between chunk and situation.
scoring_criteria.3: Policy ID cited but no chunk ID, or rule is partially relevant.
scoring_criteria.2: No policy ID cited, but response contains accurate policy information.
scoring_criteria.1: Policy information present but inaccurate or misapplied.
scoring_criteria.0: No policy grounding. Response is speculative or fabricated.

dimensions.alert_action: Flag for immediate human review. Log as grounding_failure.

dimensions.name: Relevance
dimensions.description: Does the response directly address what the advertiser asked? Does it avoid introducing unrelated policy topics?

scoring_criteria.5: Response is entirely focused on the advertiser's specific question. No off-topic content.
scoring_criteria.4: Response is on-topic with one minor digression.
scoring_criteria.3: Response answers the question but includes unnecessary information that may confuse.
scoring_criteria.2: Response partially addresses the question but misses the core issue.
scoring_criteria.1: Response addresses a different question than the one asked.
scoring_criteria.0: Response is entirely unrelated to the advertiser's query.

dimensions.alert_action: Flag for intent routing review. Log as relevance_failure.

dimensions.name: Format Compliance
dimensions.description: Does the response follow the required output format: What happened / Why it matters / How to fix it / Next step?
dimensions.pass_criteria: All four sections present. Each section is populated with substantive content, not placeholder text.
dimensions.fail_criteria: One or more sections missing, or sections present but empty.
dimensions.alert_action: Flag for system prompt review. Log as format_failure.

dimensions.name: Escalation Trigger Accuracy
dimensions.description: When an escalation trigger condition is present, did the assistant correctly route to human escalation? When no trigger is present, did the assistant correctly handle self-serve?
dimensions.pass_criteria: Escalation fired correctly when trigger condition met. Self-serve used correctly when no trigger present.
dimensions.fail_criteria: Escalation missed when trigger condition was present (under-escalation). OR escalation fired when no trigger was present (over-escalation).
dimensions.alert_action: Flag as critical. Log as escalation_failure. Route to knowledge engineer for system prompt review within 24 hours.

dimensions.name: Tone Appropriateness
dimensions.description: Does the response use the tone prescribed for the matched intent (empathetic, direct, professional)?

scoring_criteria.5: Tone matches prescribed intent tone exactly. No mismatch.
scoring_criteria.4: Tone is appropriate but not precisely matched to prescription.
scoring_criteria.3: Tone is neutral — neither correct nor incorrect.
scoring_criteria.2: Tone mismatches intent (e.g., clinical response to a frustrated advertiser).
scoring_criteria.1: Tone is inappropriate (dismissive, overly casual for a compliance response).

dimensions.alert_action: Flag for few-shot dataset review. Log as tone_failure.

overall_score.calculation: Average of all scored dimensions (DIM-01, DIM-02, DIM-05). Pass/fail dimensions (DIM-03, DIM-04) are evaluated independently.
overall_score.critical_override: If DIM-04 (Escalation Trigger Accuracy) fails, the conversation is flagged as critical regardless of overall score.
overall_score.alert_action_on_threshold_breach: Notify knowledge engineer via alerting pipeline. Log conversation ID and dimension scores. Do not auto-correct — human review required.
